R J & Associates, Cost Accountants (FRN: 004690), as Cost Auditor of the Company, in terms of Section 148 of the Companies Act, 2013 and fixed a sum of ₹ 50,000/- as remuneration plus Goods and Service Tax and out of pocket expenses, if any, payable to them, for the Financial Year 2026-27.
Capex & expansion: 2005: Acquired a steel rolling mill unit from Shah Alloys Group, increasing capacity to 6,000 MTPA; started manufacturing rolled steel products.
2006-07: Expanded rolling mill capacity to 18,000 MTPA; began manufacturing stainless steel long products ranging from 200 to 400 series grades.
Over the three-year period, the Company's total revenue increased by approximately 91%, demonstrating the continued expansion of its business operations and market reach.
Balance sheet & cash: The Company proactively addressed its legacy export receivables amounting to ₹76.26 Crores by executing a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the overseas debtor for structured phased settlement.
Maintained a cumulative provision for doubtful debts of ₹56.89 Crores up to March 31, 2026, insulating operational cash flows from credit defaults.
DIVIDEND: During the year under review, your directors have not recommended any Dividend on Equity Shares of the Company with a view to conserve resources for expansion of business.
Risks & challenges: For the global steel and alloys industry, the year presented notable headwinds, primarily driven by softer real-estate activity in major Asian economies and a subsequent influx of competitive finished imports into developing markets.
RISK MANAGEMENT: Risk Management is an integral and important component of Corporate Governance.
The Company has a Business Risk Management framework to identify, evaluate business risks and opportunities.
